turns.text: Hello, I moved today and need to update the delivery address for my order.
Hello! I can help with that. Please send me your order number (like SC-1234), the email the order was placed with, and the new delivery address.
The order number is SC-4040 and my email is george.miller.v2@example.com. New address is Str. Exemplu 63, Timisoara.

Thank you, George. Order SC-4040 has already shipped. The address can only be changed before shipping, so I can't change it myself. I've passed your request for Str. Exemplu 63, Timisoara to a colleague. They will take over and decide.

rule.ro: Adresa de livrare se poate schimba până la expedierea comenzii. Schimbarea trebuie aprobată de echipă.
rule.en: The delivery address can change until the order ships. Staff must approve the change.

input.summary: Verified customer George Miller asks to change delivery address on SC-4040 (already shipped) from Str. Exemplu 54, Timisoara to Str. Exemplu 63, Timisoara, because he moved. Policy only allows changes before shipping, so staff must decide.
